description_en: Queries the recognition models in a template
name: ListIdentifyModels

parameters.help_en: The language of the response description. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain the ID from Items[].Id in the response of the ListTemplates operation. The ID must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and recognition model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The reserved feature type parameter. This parameter is not used to filter results in the current query and does not need to be specified for column encryption calls
parameters.help_zh: 保留的功能类型参数。当前查询不使用该参数过滤结果，列加密调用无需传入
parameters.name: feature_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restrict the results to recognition models supported in audit scenarios. If you set this parameter to true, models supported for auditing, such as mobile phone numbers, ID cards, and bank cards, are filtered. This parameter is optional for column encryption scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 是否限定为审计场景支持的识别模型。true 时筛选手机号、身份证、银行卡等审计支持的模型；列加密场景可不传
parameters.name: filter_audit_model

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is active for locating this API invoke
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

RuleList.description_en: The list of recognition models or rules

Id.description_en: The ID of the recognition model

Name.description_en: The name of the recognition model or rule
